does: Keeps, on every entity in a viewshed, the set of observers whose sight holds it: adds the participant component, inserts and removes observers in its CanSee set, removes the component when nobody holds it.

evidence.says: GK.Memory hardware watch on ViewshedParticipantComponent.CanSee (+0x10) of a goblin in TestLevel_Tom: the writes when it left and re-entered the host's sight came from HashTable Remove/Ensure called at +0x2E5E784 and +0x2E5E73B of this function, itself called from +0x2E53BAC under SystemUpdate<esv::sight::ViewshedSystem>; the decompiled body adds and removes ViewshedParticipantComponent and raises ViewshedParticipantsAddedEventOneFrameComponent
